description.value:
“Exhibit G. Feeds itself. Mostly harmless.” (Open 2, rival max 6)

A stasis cube holding Ivo Marrant (NE male human wizard 9), a Technic League initiate who came looking for the Garden two years ago. Released, he is starving, terrified and still arrogant. He knows the League has a file on the Garden and has lost three agents here; he will trade everything he knows about the League's presence in Starfall for his life, and will betray the party the moment it suits him.
